conditions.warmed: every route, including the deck page and /, loaded exactly twice by document navigation before recording; deck discovery reads the first pass rather than adding a load
conditions.account: E2E_AUDIT_USER_EMAIL fixture — 2733 collection_items rows. FEWER than Hugh’s 3239, so these figures are tied to the fixture and are NOT an upper bound
conditions.deck: /decks/[id] measures the deck named above — its own cards and suggestions. The probe pins it from this field so a later run compares like with like; PROBE_DECK overrides
conditions.responseMs: PerformanceResourceTiming.duration for the slowest RSC response in the step: wall clock from fetch start to response end. NOT server compute — it includes scheduling and transfer, and swings run to run (/collection read 302ms and 738ms on runs of one build). Treat tens of ms as noise
conditions.rsc: navigation payload fetches only — speculative prefetches counted separately and excluded
conditions.document: document loads during a step. Always 0: every step is a client-side transition, and any document load means the router fell back to a full page load
